subject: Envelope encryption / key-wrapping evidence for SIG/CAIQ
messages:
From: SIG Audit Team <sig-audits@thirdpartyaudits.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: envelope encryption/key-wrapping evidence (SIG/CAIQ)

Hi Jordan,

Following up from our intake call last week — as part of the SIG + CAIQ mapping for Acme we need a focused evidence package on the envelope encryption and KMS controls you use for customer data at rest and in transit. Specifically: 

- High-level envelope-encryption diagram (DEK/KEK separation, where keys live, HSM vs cloud-KMS)
- Key wrapping algorithm and key hierarchy details (e.g., RSA-OAEP / AES-KW, KMS-wrapped DEKs)
- Recent key rotation logs (redacted key IDs acceptable) for the past 12 months
- KMS/privilege access matrix showing who/what principal can unwrap DEKs and administer KEKs
- HSM attestation / vendor certs (FIPS / module version), if you use HSMs for KEKs
- Any replay-protection or envelope integrity checks you apply on import/export of wrapped keys

Can you let us know: 1) whether you can provide these artifacts as a packet, and 2) preferred transfer mechanism (SFTP, secure Drive link, or portal)? Also include an estimate of when rotation logs can be exported.

Thanks,
Rajiv (on behalf of SIG Audit Team)
[SIG Audit Team]
[sig-audits@thirdpartyaudits.com]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: SIG Audit Team <sig-audits@thirdpartyaudits.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: envelope encryption/key-wrapping evidence (SIG/CAIQ)

Hi Rajiv — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you requested. Quick clarifying points so we scope redaction correctly: 

- For rotation logs we can supply exported audit records with key IDs and timestamps; we will redact actual key material and principal GUIDs on request (we can provide a mapping under NDA).
- Our default KEK storage is a FIPS-validated HSM cluster for our Dedicated & Private customers; for hosted projects we use cloud KMS with envelope encryption (DEK wrapped by customer-specific KEK).
- Envelope encryption diagram and the KMS access matrix are straightforward. HSM attestation certs are with our vendor and we'll include the latest module attestation (FIPS 140-2/3 statement).

Plan: Marissa will assemble the packet and Neha will export rotation logs with redactions. We can put the packet on an SFTP drop or a secure Drive link depending on what you prefer.

Can you confirm whether you need raw syslog entries versus the exported rotation CSV (we typically provide CSV with event, key_id (redacted), action, actor_role, timestamp)? Also, are you mapping these artifacts into specific CAIQ questions so we can label items accordingly?

-jb
Jordan Blake
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

[Attachment stubs: envelope_encryption_diagram.pdf (will be included in packet), rotation-schedule.xlsx (current rotation cadence)]

- envelope_encryption_diagram.pdf [Attachment: 92 KB] — annotated DEK/KEK flow, noted where TLS v1.3 mutual auth is required for internal unwrapping calls.
- kms-access-matrix.csv [Attachment: 18 KB] — role -> action mapping (Decrypt/Unwrap, Encrypt/Wrap, Administer).
- rotation-schedule.xlsx [Attachment: 14 KB] — current rotation cadence (KEKs: quarterly by default; DEKs: automatic per-object rotation where enabled).
- hsm_attestation_vendor_cert.pdf [not included in Drive preview; available on SFTP]
- rotation_logs_202512-202612_redacted.csv [on SFTP only — contains event, redacted_key_id, action, actor_role, timestamp]

SFTP drop details: sftp.thirdpartyaudits.com:/incoming/acme-redwood (account will be provisioned to sig-audits@thirdpartyaudits.com; credentials will be sent separately). Drive packet: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/s/secure/ACME-SIG-PACK-20261210 (view restricted).

Notes / callouts: 
- KEKs for Dedicated/Private deployments are backed by an on-prem HSM cluster (FIPS 140-2 Level 3) — vendor attestation, module version and serials are available via SFTP.
- For hosted customers we keep customer-specific KEKs in cloud KMS and use envelope encryption. The wrapping uses AES-GCM for DEK encryption at rest and RSA-OAEP for cross-region KEK transfers (when exporting wrapped keys for migration).
- Rotation logs: Neha exported the last 12 months and redacted direct principals; we retained roles and service account IDs hashed for traceability. If you need unredacted principals we can discuss an NDA-scoped mapping.
